label: Bible Study
prompt: Every man shall give as he is _____, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
verse: Every man shall give as he is able, according to the blessing of the LORD thy God which he hath given thee.
note: The pilgrim-feast rule for giving — not a fixed price, but in proportion to how you've been blessed.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he took them up in his _____, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
verse: And he took them up in his arms, put his hands upon them, and blessed them.
note: Jesus didn't just tolerate the children — He scooped them up in His arms and blessed them.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be _____.
verse: And it came to pass in those days, that there went out a decree from Caesar Augustus, that all the world should be taxed.
note: The Christmas story starts with paperwork: Caesar's decree that 'all the world should be taxed' sent Joseph to Bethlehem.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But ye, brethren, be not _____ in well doing.
verse: But ye, brethren, be not weary in well doing.
note: Paul's tag after rebuking the idlers: don't let the freeloaders make you quit doing good.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Charity never _____: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
verse: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
note: 'Charity never faileth' — prophecies, tongues, and knowledge all have an expiry date; love doesn't.
